list.heading: Groups
list.description: Bundle friends into named groups, then share sessions and polls with just them.

owned.title: You don't own any groups yet
owned.body: Create a group like "D&D crew" and invite the friends you play with most.

memberOf.title: No groups from friends yet
memberOf.body: When a friend adds you to one of their groups, it shows up here after you accept.

invited.title: No invites out
invited.body: Invite friends and they'll appear here until they accept or decline.

invite.dialogDescription: They join the group once they accept.

multiSelect.allInvited: Everyone on your friends list is already here.

newGroup.title: New group
newGroup.description: Name it, then invite friends. They join once they accept.

rename.title: Rename group
rename.description: Everyone in the group sees the new name.

delete.title: Delete “{{group}}”?
delete.description: Members lose access to anything shared with this group. This can't be undone.

leave.title: Leave “{{group}}”?
leave.description: You'll stop seeing sessions and polls shared with this group.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.description: They lose access to anything shared with this group. You can invite them again later.

danger.title: Delete group
danger.description: Members lose access to anything shared with this group. This can't be undone.

notFound.title: This group no longer exists
notFound.description: It may have been deleted, or you left it.

codes.group_not_found: This group is no longer available.
codes.group_limit_reached: You've reached the limit of 50 groups.
codes.group_member_limit_reached: This group has reached its member limit.
codes.group_name_taken: You already have a group with that name.
codes.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.
